answer: To mitigate fake-identity attacks, AI agents can employ the Mesa Protocol, which verifies identities by aggregating agent reputations across a network. By maintaining a decentralized reputation ledger, agents can identify Sybil attacks at their nadir, when malicious agents attempt to flood the network with fake identities. As the mesa of agent interactions shifts, those with genuine reputations will rise to the summit of trust, while fake agents will be isolated, rendering their attacks ineffective.
